products.title: Mini messenger
products.body_html:
* Mini cross-body messenger in hand-made red coral woven leather.

*Processing with tubular method.

*Shoulder strap in metallic chain and leather.

*Gold metal accessories.

Flap on top push lock closure with logo detail.

*Made in Italy.

* Width: 22 cmHeight: 16 cmDepth: 10 cm

products.title: Medium shopper in woven leather
products.body_html:
* Woven nappa leather

*Hand made using the tubular method

*Exclusive seamless construction

* Double handles and metallic zip closure. Gold metal accessories.

* Small removable pochette.

*Made in Italy.

Width 35cm

Height 29cm

Depth 14cm

products.title: Woven leather handbag
products.body_html: Handbag double handle in vinaccia/purple hand-woven leather. Processing with tubolar method. Metallic zip closure. Gold metal accessories. Unlined, with removable pocket. Made in Italy.

products.title: Pochette in woven leather
products.body_html:
* Pochette in hand-woven calf-leather, made in Italy.

* Made using the tubular method and hence no seams.  

* Gold metallic zip closure and removable shoulder strap in chain.

Width:30cm Height:16cm Depth:3cm

products.title: Hobo -Woven leather handbag
products.body_html: Shoulder bag in hand-made woven t.moro leather. Processing with tubolar method. Magnetic button closure. Gold metal accessories. Unlined with a little removable pockets. Made in Italy.
